parties: India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL); Committee of Creditors (CoC); DPSC Limited
headline: DPSC Limited: 4th CoC Meeting under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process for IPCL
sum: India Power Corporation Limited (IPCL) is undergoing a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), with the 4th Committee of Creditors meeting scheduled. DPSC Limited filed the intimation with NSE under Regulation 30 of the LODR, signalling material developments in IPCL's creditor resolution.
implication: The progression to a 4th CoC meeting indicates the CIRP is in active negotiation or resolution phase; transactional counsel must monitor for resolution plan approval, liquidation triggers, or creditor class objections under IBC s.30/31 framework.
detail: India Power Corporation Limited has entered formal insolvency proceedings under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code. DPSC Limited's intimation to NSE of the 4th Committee of Creditors meeting is a mandatory disclosure under LODR Regulation 30, indicating material corporate action. The CoC's repeated convening suggests either ongoing resolution plan deliberation, creditor dissent, or statutory milestones in the 180/270-day CIRP timeline. The intimation does not specify the resolution plan status, creditor acceptance threshold, or proposed outcome.
